title: "Tool Cancellation Causes Session Termination in Bash Command Execution"
body:
**Bug Description**
So if you cancel a tool, like I did, where it was a bash command that runs a program, there wasn't an exit, it breaks the session. :(

**Environment Info**
- Platform: darwin
- Terminal: WarpTerminal
- Version: 1.0.34
- Feedback ID: c08e4d55-87aa-4080-8932-d266e653e40f
